name: Week 14 KB Saturday Cardio — Conditioning Cave Pull (Spotlight: Asgooch Cardio Complex)
description: Saturday KB OPTION — pure conditioning. Distinct from Tue (strength template) and Thu (lighter strength template). The user's brief: 'harder Asgooch stuff but more reps / more variety / less weight is more or less conditioning.' Pulls in three pieces we haven't drilled before — the Asgooch CARDIO complex (row/clean/squat/snatch × 6 × 5 rounds, a different complex than the overhead Asgooch flow already on Tue), the halo-to-reverse-lunge + figure-8-to-reverse-lunge flow combos (from kb-conditioning-blast), and a high-rep controlled-power finisher (from kb-daily-controlled-power). Light bell throughout (16-20lb working) — sustainability and breathing rate are the targets, not load. Choice-of-the-day on D6; alternates with Stairmaster, easy run, or rest.

dayOverview.theme: Saturday conditioning. Different intent from Tue/Thu — light bell, more reps, more variety, breathing-rate target. Cave pulls: Asgooch cardio complex, halo/figure-8 to reverse lunge flow combos, controlled-power high-rep finisher. Day after Friday legs — squatting stays LIGHT on purpose.

spotlights.why: The 4th move in the Asgooch cardio complex — 6 reps × 5 rounds per side at light bell is where conditioning actually lives. Spotlight the snatch cue (hips drive, punch through, smooth catch — don't bang the forearm) because this is where the load + speed combo gets sloppy first.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W14 Sat launches conditioning template (Asgooch cardio complex + flow combos + controlled-power finisher). W15+ rotate the finisher block — controlled-power one week, brutal complex variants the next, 100-rep blocks pulled from kb-100-rep-daily-challenge.
watchpoints: **Day after Friday legs.** Squatting in the cardio complex (front squat × 6) stays LIGHT — 16-20lb. Don't chase load. Skip the front-squat reps if QL/quads are talking.
**Light bell is the whole point.** Asgooch ran his cardio complex at 24kg (53lb) — that's NOT the target here. 16-20lb is. Conditioning means breathing rate, not bell weight.

**Asgooch CARDIO complex is different from Tuesday's Asgooch OVERHEAD complex** — same author, different chain. Cardio = row/clean/squat/snatch (mostly low-and-explosive). Overhead = row/snatch/OH lunge/OH squat/push press (overhead-loaded).
**Pull-up greasing skipped here** — the Sat KB day is the conditioning flank, not part of the pull-up frequency push. (Pull frequency = Wed pull + Mon push warmup + Tue KB strength block.)
**Right shoulder watch on the snatch** — the punch-through at the top is where the catch can crash. Light bell + smooth catch; if it crackles, drop to high pulls instead.

**This is a CHOICE-OF-THE-DAY on D6**, not mandatory. Skip if Friday legs cooked you, swap for stairmaster or easy run if cardio-only is the right call. The KB option exists so cardio doesn't have to mean a treadmill.

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Loosen shoulders fast — no slow warmup today, the cardio complex is its own warmup.
Easy two-handed swings. Prime the hinge.
Light, open the hips. Skip if Friday legs left the quads sore.
Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Wakes grip + forearm + posterior chain — primes the snatch catch.

sets.name: Quick Banded Prep (~2 min — abbreviated)

exercises.notes: Mini-band overhead.
Scaps depress.
Rear delts fire.
Sternum height, ribs down.

sets.notes: **Abbreviated prep** — 4 moves instead of the full 7. Saturday is conditioning; the full template's 7-move prep is overkill for a light-bell day.

sets.name: 🔆 Asgooch Cardio Complex — LEFT (Spotlight Block)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Left hand. Hips back, back flat, pull elbow past ribs. 2s pull, 2s lower.
Left hand. **Hip drive into the rack** — thumb to collarbone. Smooth catch — knees absorb.
Left rack. **LIGHT** — Friday legs is yesterday. Sit tall, full depth IF the legs are fresh; reduce depth before load if they're cooked.

🔆 Left hand. **Spotlight:**
- **Hips drive the bell**, not the arm — arm just guides
- **Punch THROUGH at the top** — don't pull the bell into a stop
- **Smooth catch** — bell rotates around the forearm, no bang
- Right shoulder watch on the catch — if it crackles, sub high pulls for the last 2 rounds

sets.notes: 5 rounds LEFT. Continuous within a round — row→clean→squat→snatch with no rest. Rest 30-45s between rounds. **Weak side first.** Different from Tuesday's overhead Asgooch — same author, different chain.

sets.name: Asgooch Cardio Complex — RIGHT

exercises.notes: Right hand. Same form — hips back, full extension.
Right hand. Smooth clean to rack.
Right rack. Same depth/load discipline as left.
Right hand. **Right shoulder watchpoint on the catch** — same modify-to-high-pull rule.

sets.notes: 5 rounds RIGHT. Continuous within a round. **If the workout is running long after the left side, drop to 3-4 rounds right — don't grind a quality session into a sloppy one.**

sets.name: Flow Combos — Halo/Figure-8 to Reverse Lunge (NEW from KB Conditioning Blast)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. Halo one direction → reverse lunge → halo other direction → reverse lunge other leg. Continuous, fluid. The halo loosens the shoulder while the lunge keeps the legs honest.
Figure-8 pass between the legs → step back into a reverse lunge → switch sides. The figure-8 cues hip rotation; the lunge anchors it. Coordination drill as much as conditioning.

sets.notes: New flow shapes for W14. The halo-to-lunge and figure-8-to-lunge are coordination-conditioning hybrids — the upper-body skill challenge slows the leg work down enough that the lunges don't dump the quads. 3 rounds, 30-45s rest between rounds.

sets.name: Controlled Power Finisher — High-Rep Block (NEW from @metabolicfactor)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 16-20lb. 20 each direction. Smooth circles, torso quiet. Different from the single-leg version — both feet down here.
Side-to-side swings across the body. Drive from hips, core rotates. Controlled arc, no flailing.
Explosive hip snap, pull the bell to chin height. Elbows high. Controlled lower.
Light goblet. **SKIP if quads are toast from Friday legs** — the finisher works without it. Full depth, chest up.

sets.notes: One straight set through, ~5-6 min. **Skip the goblet squat block if Friday legs is still in the legs** — this is the lever to dial back without losing the finisher. Conditioning lives in the around-body-pass + side-swing + high-pull stack; the squat is the optional cherry on top.

exercises.notes: Slow spine wave. Decompress after the high-rep finisher.
60s each side. Hip flexor release — counters the lunge flow + cardio complex squat reps.
60s. Adductors take a hit from the figure-8 + lateral shapes.
